text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The second leg of the Classic Triple 
Crown, the Japanese Derby. Rumors spread 
that 'the other Umamusume of her 
generation would be intimidated by Narita 
Brian'...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer grows anxious over the nasty 
rumors. However, Narita Brian brushes them 
off as mere noise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every Umamusume of that generation was 
truly aiming for victory. Narita Brian was 
delighted by this, her fighting spirit 
blazing.
